verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client. Git clients can plausibly ship a companion CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only Shortcuts actions, an x-callback-url deep-link scheme, a WebDAV server and an in-app Repository Agent. These are adjacent automation surfaces, not an official command-line interface, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
